title: The God Delusion
author: Richard Dawkins
summary: Richard Dawkins argues that belief in a supernatural creator is almost certainly false and that religion does harm. He examines arguments for God, the roots of belief and the basis of morality.
readIf: you want a forceful, well-known case for atheism, written in a confident voice.
skipIf: you want a respectful, balanced treatment of faith or dislike polemic.
